title: volkswagen targets 9 operating margin by 2030 2026 09 03
text: FRANKFURT, Sept 3 (Reuters) - Volkswagen targets ​an operating ‌margin of 9% ​by ​2030, up from 3.8% ⁠in ​the first ​six months of 2026, it ​said ​on Thursday, part ‌of ⁠a sweeping turnaround plan that ​was ​approved ⁠by the ​group's supervisory ​board ⁠late on Thursday.
